dedupe_keys.name: solid waste management stakeholders database democratic republic of congo

description: People in Need deposits a Bio4HUMAN stakeholder database for waste management and bio-based initiatives in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Zenodo lists one public Excel workbook under CC BY 4.0. The provider describes an executive summary, an inventory, definitions and sheets for industry, humanitarian organisations, government and policy actors, communities and academia. These categories could help define actor types and institutional coordination assumptions in an agent-based waste-service simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Democratic Republic of Congo stakeholder map; a separate Bio4HUMAN workbook covers South Sudan and should not be merged with it. A limitation is that the landing page omits the number of actors, sampling date, provinces, service areas and observed ties. The workbook does not claim to contain waste volumes, collection routes, processing capacities or measured service performance. Those inputs would need other sources. The workbook was not downloaded and no row-level check was made.
